lines: The unpleasant smell of burning flesh was filling the small bar.
Sago's hands had reached extreme temperatures, and with them he was burning through the huge bodies of the approaching trolls one after the other.
(He's strong...!! I can't believe my dirtbag dad had a guy like this as a subordinate...!!)
I couldn't contain my admiration while I was also fighting back the trolls.
The cyborg and former Taimanin quickly repelled the group of monsters rushing into the bar.
At the same time, I felt an inexpressible sadness to see that even a man as strong as him had lost his way―
It had happened without warning. A strange noise reverberated from Sago's body as he was vanquishing the Trolls with his superhuman strength, and his movements lost their edge.
Damn it...!! Looks like this body can't even make it through a small skirmish like this anymore...!
(I see...! That cyborg body has almost reached the end of its lifespan...)
Since he didn't have access to UFS maintenance, the broken parts could not be repaired.
And now, Sago could only show his former strength for but a brief moment.
The Trolls attacked Sago with no regard for his predicament.
If I didn't go to his rescue, Sago would be in danger, but―
I already had my hands full with the trolls that were coming after me.
Sago was down on his knees while a club swung by a troll was barreling toward him. At that moment―
Accompanied by a battle cry, a giant blade swung down and instantly turned the Troll's massive body into chunks of meat.
Flower petals danced through the air and the trolls surrounding Sago began to writhe in agony.
Following Shizuru and the Oni warrior, Hebiko and Shikanosuke also came down from the second floor.
H-Hey!? What's going on, I was having such a good sleep!?
Fuma-kun. Just when I was thinking it was noisy down here, it looks like you were really in trouble.
Yes... I don't know how, but it looks like our hideout has been discovered.
The four of them moved into position to face the horde of monsters and protect Sago.
He had regained his footing for the time being, but we were not out of the woods yet.
Fuma-chan! There's a bad smell coming from outside the bar―Heberybody is probably surrounded.
Despite the strenuous efforts of Shizuru and the others, the Trolls' offensive did not abate in the slightest.
There must have been several squads surrounding the hideout.
This isn't good... As the commotion is growing, the residents of the underworld are going to gather. That will put us at a disadvantage.
Aieeee!!! Th-Then what should we dooo!!?
Let's see... Fuma-kun!! I'll take care of things here. And you, on the other hand―
We'll escape and bring Sago-san with us. ―That's what you were going to say, right?
Yes. The escape route is as we discussed in the evening. Have you memorized it properly?
I have a pretty good memory, yeah.
Shizuru winked mischievously and turned to face Yamata no Orochi.
I'll create an opening for a moment with my Jutsu. Yamata no Orochi―smash through the siege with your sword!
Yamata no Orochi grinned and raised her freakish, giant sword.
We're going too!! Hebiko, take care of Sago-san!!
Hebiko, who had transformed into an octopus, used her powerful octopus tentacles to lift up Sago, who was still unable to move.
Make sure to stay alive, Shizuru!! Let's meet again in Gosha!!!
Hehe, of course. I mean, I've got a class to teach you all at the beginning of the week♪
The horde of ferocious Trolls cried out savagely and attacked.
And with Shizuru's support, we were able to break right through the middle of them.
